body.statement: The construction has the following exact sanity reductions. First, if \(\ell=u=0\), \(C\mu=0\), and the rectangular anchor \(\mathsf{RA}\) holds, then \(\mathcal A_{\mathrm{cyc}}(\mu)=\{0\}\) and each target is point identified by the usual not-yet-treated two-by-two functional \[\theta_j=(\nu_j-\mu_{(g_j,b_j)})-(\mu_{(q_j,t_j)}-\mu_{(q_j,b_j)}).\] Second, if every positive-width edge is a bridge and the bounded-baseline inequalities are slack throughout the primitive box, the bridge frontier and the transshipment support values reduce to the independent-box calculation. Third, order a four-cycle so \(C=(1,-1,1,-1)\), give its first and third coordinates intervals \([0,1]\), fix its second and fourth coordinates at zero, and set \(C\mu=0\). Then the fiber is \(\{0\}\), \(\mathcal I(\mu)=\varnothing\), and the corrected dimension is \(0=|\mathcal I(\mu)|-\operatorname{rank}(C_{\mathcal I(\mu)})\); the unqualified positive-width expression would instead equal \(2-1=1\). Finally, in \(\mathfrak W_3\), the cycle equations give \[\mathcal A_{\mathrm{cyc}}(\mu)=\{a:a_{h,2}=0,\ (a_{4,3},a_{5,3},a_{6,3})=(z+1/2,z,z),\ -1\le z\le1/2\}.\] Therefore \(a_{4,3}-a_{5,3}=1/2\) and the exact support of \(\psi_3\) is \([-3/4,3/4]\), whereas optimizing the same equal-weight functional over the uncoupled primitive box gives \([-1,1]\).
body.justification: The proposition verifies the anchored no-anticipation corner, the boundary-face dimension correction, and the strict coupled contraction by direct rational calculations.
body.gap: CallawaySantAnna2021 supplies the anchored zero-anticipation two-by-two functional, while no published source records the face-correct dimension diagnostic or the fully specified three-cohort contraction induced by shared anticipatory cells.
body.consumer: The four-cycle and three-cohort calculations are exact unit tests for dimension and endpoint software, and the anchor condition prevents a disconnected target gauge from being mislabeled as point identified.
